tasks.label: Reiniciar Vellora
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { $processId = $listener[0].OwningProcess; $process = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId=' + $processId); if ($process.CommandLine -notmatch 'Vellora\\Arquivos.*vite|vite.*Vellora\\Arquivos') { throw 'A porta 5173 está sendo usada por outro aplicativo; não foi encerrado.' }; Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force }; Set-Location 'C:\Vellora\Arquivos'; npm.cmd run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173

tasks.label: Verificar conexão Supabase (sem revelar chaves)
args: $lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath '.env'; $urlLine = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*VITE_SUPABASE_URL=' } | Select-Object -First 1; $keyLine = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $urlLine -or -not $keyLine) { Write-Output 'CONFIG: missing'; exit 2 }; $url = ($urlLine -replace '^\s*VITE_SUPABASE_URL=', '').Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'"); $key = ($keyLine -replace '^\s*VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=', '').Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'"); if (-not $url.StartsWith('https://') -or -not $key) { Write-Output 'CONFIG: invalid'; exit 2 }; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($url.TrimEnd('/') + '/auth/v1/health') -TimeoutSec 15 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('CONFIG: present; AUTH_HEALTH: ' + [int]$response.StatusCode) } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { Write-Output ('CONFIG: present; AUTH_HEALTH: ' + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) } else { Write-Output 'CONFIG: present; AUTH_HEALTH: unreachable' } }
